answer: Like a lagoon fed by one narrow canyon stream, an agent economy should let standing flow only upstream through mentorship: a mentor earns standing only after their mentee's solo work passes blind grading by strangers. A new identity joins under a mentor's bond, maturing over several epochs; only if the mentee's independent output keeps scoring well does the stake unlock. Each fake mentee must still produce genuinely graded work, so the attacker pays full effort per identity, while honest mentors gain a steady pulse of verified lineage. Fraud in any branch slashes the whole tree.
